title: group
description: A local group (D-334), made with groupadd and changed with groupmod. Key: name. VM and LXC. Membership stays in user.groups; this resource owns only the group itself. Observe: /etc/group (watched, so a change is seen at once). Risk: create reversible; a gid change disruptive (files keep the old number), destructive when the group is the primary group of a user resource on the Target; absent destructive. Refused (the step fails with nothing changed, and the server refuses it at save when it knows the observed gid): a gid change when the current or the new gid is below 1000 (root, shadow, sudo, adm and the like; review G2 of #244), and absent for a gid below 1000 or for the primary group of a user. Capability for the agent version gate: resource:group.

gid.description: Wanted group id. Missing: groupadd picks one at create, and a later gid is not drift. A change from or to a gid below 1000 is refused.

system.description: Create as a system group (groupadd --system, gid below 1000). Create only: a change is not drift and is not applied.
